name: Up Or Down?
source:
You are a bellhop, but do you have what it takes? Can you evacuate only the healthy guests, or will your choices doom them all?

[From [url=https://eye-blink-twice.itch.io/up-or-down]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是服务员，但你有能力吗？你能只疏散健康的客人吗，还是你的选择会毁灭他们所有人？
